asr.full_text: This is Shah and Doge, just respected the level exactly as we mapped it in the last update. Right now price is trading around 0.10 Previously, after losing the mini support at 0.11, we clearly said that direction shifts to the downside and the next major level to watch was the support at 0.10 that move played out cleanly Price drop towards 0.10 and on the four hour time frame, we even saw candles closing below that support. At first glance, that looked like a breakdown, but this is where Time Frame Context becomes important. While lower time frames showed weakness, the Daily Candle told a different story. On the Daily chart, Price left only a week below $170 per share. This is due to the strong closeback above. The price stayed below the $0.10 period when the selling price started to fall. There are some underlying concerns as well. It is important to note that at the beginning of today's video, I am going to talk about another trade that I am going to discuss today. This is the current trade that is on this chart. The daily candle on the chart shows that the price left below the level triggered stops and buyers stepped in and absorbed the selling pressure. Now the downside target towards 0.10 has already been achieves, that objective is done. The question now is, what happens next. As long as DOGE continues to hold above 0.10 on daily closes, the Buyers shifts from bearish to cautiously bullish in the short-term support that survives a breakdown attempt becomes even more important if buyers continue defending this level and we start to see higher lows forming on the lower time frames that opens the door for a bounce however the confirmation condition is very clear. Daily closes must remain above 0.10%. If we start seeing daily candles closing decisively below this level, with body acceptance under it, then the breakdown becomes real. And we would reassess for further downside. But right now that confirmation is not there. The market already completed the move towards support. The liquidity below 0.10 has been tapped. The daily structure is showing defense at this level. That means this is not the area to panic short after the move has already happened. The structure from here is simple. Hold 0. ten on daily closes and we can expect upside attempts. Loose 0.10 with strong daily acceptance below it, and then we talk about continuation lower. Until that happens, support is still valid. Stay patient and let the daily timeframe guide the bias. The target to the downside is already completed. Now the market needs to prove whether it wants to reverse or break further.
